div.head: VIII Atr 11.1
div.ab: ⁊ se þe ðæt ne gelæste, forgilde hine mid twelffealdan, ⁊ þam cyninge CXX scill'.
⁊ se þe ðæt ne gelæste, forgilde hine mid twelffealdan ⁊ þam cyninge CXX scill'.
And se þe ðæt ne gelæste forgilde hine mid twelffealdan, and þam cyninge CXX scillinga.
und wer das nicht leistet, vergelte sie mit Zwölffachem, und dem König 120 Schilling.
and whoever does not pay it, let him pay it twelvefold, and 120 shillings to the king.
And he who fails to do so shall pay them twelve-fold and [give] 120 shillings to the king.
And anyone who does not pay them must render them twelvefold and pay one hundred and twenty shillings to the king.

note.label: source (roman)
note.quote: Table 5.4, I Cn 10:1: (HomN LXI) VIII Atr 11:1

note.seg: Vermutlich aus Ine 4, der aber nur 60 Schill. Strafgeld fordert
Presumably from Ine 4, which, however, demands a fine of only 60 shill.
Cf. In. 4 (where the fine is only 60 sh.); I Cn. 10. The same offence is threatened with excommunication in I Edm. 2 and with incurring the wrath of God in IV Edg. 1, 3.
